name: Lovestar
source:
High school isn’t what you expected. From Eva’s dangerous lessons to Gunner’s ridiculous errands, every choice changes your story. Can you handle the madness?

[From [url=https://pommisc.itch.io/lovestar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中生活跟你想的可不一樣。從伊娃那堂堂危險的課，到岡納派來的荒唐差事，每個選擇都會改變你的故事。你能應付得了這些瘋事嗎？
